verdict.rationale: Only unity-docs-1's tagline ('Build 2D and 3D games for any platform') references 2D at all; the rest of the evidence pack is dominated by 3D rendering, multiplayer, and platform-build docs with no mention of sprites, Tilemap, 2D physics, or 2D-specific tooling. Missing for 10: dedicated 2D sprite/animation docs, Tilemap system evidence, 2D physics engine documentation, and any community corroboration that 2D is treated as first-class rather than a side feature.
